case_title: YONG QUAN WU VS. HOUSE OF LOUIE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $325.50 FILED BY WU, YONG QUAN AS TO DEFENDANT HOUSE OF LOUIE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-26-2008 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
APPLICATION FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68511.3 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF WU, YONG QUAN ORDER GRANTING WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO CRC 3.50 - 3.63
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $0.00(WAIVED) SERVED NOV-07-2008, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT HOUSE OF LOUIE

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-26-2008 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF PRESENT. DEFENDANT NOT PRESENT. CANTONESE INTERPRETER KENNY FUNG PRESENT ON PLAINTIFF'S BEHALF. COMMISSIONER PAUL SLAVIT. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF WU, YONG QUAN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HOUSE OF LOUIE $325.50 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $325.50, THE COURT ORDERS RESCISSION OF THE PURCHASE AGREEMENT. DEFENDANT SHALL REFUND THE PURCHASE PRICE OF THE CLOTHES DRYER PLUS TAX; PLAINTIFF SHALL MAKE THE DRYER AVAILABLE FOR PICK UP BY DEFENDANT, AT DEFENDANT'S EXPENSE. DEFENDANT HOUSE OF LOUIE NOT PRESENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
